name: macOS head -n compatibility in archive script
description: The PRD archive functionality fails silently on macOS because it uses GNU-specific `head -n -1` syntax which isn't supported by BSD head.

context.symptom: After ALL_COMPLETE, archive step outputs 'head: illegal line count -- -1' and completed PRDs remain in prds/ instead of moving to prd-archive/
context.rootCause: GNU coreutils `head -n -1` (remove last line) doesn't work on macOS BSD head
context.impact: Completed PRDs accumulate in prds/ folder, cluttering the work queue view

userStories.title: Archive works on macOS
userStories.description: As a FADE user on macOS, I want completed PRDs to be archived properly so that my prds/ folder only contains active work.
acceptanceCriteria: Archive functionality works on macOS (BSD head/sed)
Archive functionality still works on Linux (GNU coreutils)
Completed PRDs are moved from fade/prds/ to fade/prd-archive/
No error messages during archive process

userStories.title: Archive handles legacy structure
userStories.description: As a FADE user with legacy project structure, I want archive to work with prds/ at root as well as fade/prds/.
acceptanceCriteria: Falls back to prds/ at root (legacy structure)
Moves to corresponding archive folder (fade/prd-archive/ or prd-archive/)

technicalNotes.currentCode: Likely uses `head -n -1` somewhere in archive logic
technicalNotes.fix: Replace `head -n -1 file` with `sed '$d' file` for cross-platform compatibility
technicalNotes.alternative: Or use `ghead` from Homebrew coreutils, but sed is more portable
technicalNotes.testOn: Verify fix works on both macOS and Linux
